title: 431. Android Unlock Patterns

examples.explanation: Nine choices for a single dot.
Only the valid two-hop patterns count.

hints: Precompute the jumped dot for every ordered pair (most pairs need none).
Depth-first search over used-dot masks, adding to the total whenever length reaches [m, n].
Exploit symmetry: corners (1,3,7,9) match, edges (2,4,6,8) match, center (5) is unique.
